reader_contract.figure_question: Is the C5 successor-reuse result positive across networks and protected against dependence on the development seed or intervention leakage?
reader_contract.terminal_inference: Both next-processing and next-successor endpoints are positive in every tested network at K1 and K5, the estimates persist in the confirmatory 19-network cohort, and all frozen intervention-identity gates pass.
forbidden_inferences: C5 establishes necessity, complete mediation, or uniqueness.
K1 and K5 effect magnitudes were compared by a prespecified inferential test.
The Layer 2 and Layer 3 endpoints estimate one interchangeable biological quantity.
C5 establishes a causal relation to Fig.5 morphology or Fig.6 conditional function.

semantic_units.reader_task: Inspect K1 and K5 early Layer-2 donor-transfer values across all 20 networks.
Inspect K1 and K5 post-C Layer-3 donor-transfer values across all 20 networks.
Compare each confirmatory-19 estimate with its overlapping full-20 reference.
Verify Layer-2-only transfer, preserved receiver state, reset fast state, identical C, and sham identity.

comparison_obligations.reader_action: Read K1 and K5 within each endpoint panel without treating their visual separation as a tested depth contrast.
Compare confirmatory-19 and full-20 summaries for the same endpoint-by-K row.

topology_invariants: The two core endpoint distributions occupy adjacent first-row slots.
The cohort sensitivity occupies the lower-left slot after the two core endpoints.
The identity audit is the final lower-right panel and remains visually subordinate.
Layer 2 and Layer 3 distributions remain separate panels.
No retired formation-bridge experiment or Fig.5-to-Fig.6 bridge is present.
topology_freedoms: Gate-label abbreviation and tick density may be reduced inside the frozen slots.
Deterministic network jitter may be adjusted without changing the summaries.

comparison_groups.comparison_basis: same 20 networks and K1/K5 ordering but endpoint-specific scales
comparison_groups.reader_task: verify within-endpoint network prevalence without making a cross-endpoint magnitude test

alignment_groups.comparison_basis: same networks and K ordering with endpoint-specific y scales

alignment_groups.rationale: stable lower-row rhythm despite different chart grammars
alignment_groups.comparison_basis: robustness closure panels share vertical extent but encode distinct statistical and audit quantities

topology.rationale: core endpoints lead, cohort robustness follows, and the engineering identity audit closes the final alternative

hard_constraints: two equal 48 mm rows with two equal slots in each row
identity audit must remain the final panel
all six identity gates must be computed from all 160 persisted audit rows
raw network points must remain visible in panels a and b
full-20 and confirmatory-19 cohorts are overlapping, not independent
soft_targets: center the cohort legend above panel c
